## Download

Download `IconPicker-<version>-win-x64.zip` below, extract it anywhere and run `Icon Picker\IconPicker.exe`. Nothing is installed.

- **Windows protected your PC**: the app isn't code-signed yet. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or right-click the zip, choose **Properties** and tick **Unblock** before extracting.
- **Updating**: extract the new zip to the same place, over the old `Icon Picker` folder. Settings and saved icons are kept.
- **Checking the download**: the `.sha256` file holds the zip's SHA-256 hash, which `Get-FileHash` in PowerShell shows too.
- **Requirements**: Windows 11, 64-bit. Windows 10 version 2004 or later should work, but hasn't been tested.

See the [README](https://github.com/Fuzen777/IconPicker#readme) for what the app does.
